body.zh-Hant: 卡隆德1863年12月7日生於斯庫爾，1952年6月14日卒於蘇黎世。他在伯爾尼完成法學學業並取得博士學位（1889年），1890年起在庫爾執業律師。
body.en: Felix Calonder was born in Scuol on 7 December 1863 and died in Zürich on 14 June 1952. He completed his law studies with a doctorate in Bern in 1889 and began work as an advocate in Chur in 1890.

citations.quote: 1889 schloss er das Rechtsstud. mit der Promotion in Bern ab.
1890 nahm er seine Arbeit als Advokat in Chur auf.

heading.en: Cantonal and federal legislator, party leader

body.zh-Hant: 1891至1913年他是格勞賓登邦大議會議員（1896、1899年任議長），1899至1913年為聯邦議會的邦代表院（Ständerat）議員。他長期擔任格勞賓登自由派（Freisinn）的主席。1912年他在聯邦委員補選中敗給埃德蒙·舒爾特斯。
body.en: He sat in the Grisons Grand Council from 1891 to 1913 (president in 1896 and 1899) and was a member of the Council of States from 1899 to 1913. He long presided over the Grisons Freisinn. In 1912 he lost a Federal Council by-election to Edmund Schulthess.

citations.quote: 1891-1913 sass C. im bündner. Gr. Rat (1896 und 1899 Präs.)
1899-1913 war er Mitglied des Ständerats.
gab dem Bündner Freisinn, den er lange präsidierte,
1912 unterlag er in einer Bundesrats-Ersatzwahl Edmund Schulthess.

body.zh-Hant: 1913年聯邦議會選他為格勞賓登的第二位、也是第一位羅曼什人聯邦委員。他主管內政部至1917年底，1918至1919年主管政治部（外交）。1918年11月全國大罷工期間他起初猶豫，後以聯邦主席身分採取軍方高層的強硬立場。1920年1月21日他宣布辭職。
body.en: In 1913 the Federal Assembly elected him as the second Grisonian and first Romansh speaker on the Federal Council. He headed the Department of the Interior until the end of 1917 and the Political Department in 1918–19. During the November 1918 general strike he hesitated at first and then, as federal president, adopted the hard line of the army leadership. He announced his resignation on 21 January 1920.

citations.quote: 1913 wählte die Bundesversammlung C. als zweiten Bündner
und ersten Rätoromanen zum Bundesrat.
Dem Dep. des Innern stand er bis Ende 1917 vor, dem Polit. Dep. 1918-19.
Während des Landesstreiks im Nov. 1918 zögerte C.,
übernahm dann aber als Bundespräs. die harte Haltung von Armeespitze
Am 21.1.1920 erklärte C. seinen Rücktritt.

heading.en: League of Nations mission and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1922至1937年他受國際聯盟之託，在卡托維茲（波蘭）監督德波上西里西亞協定的遵守。1937年後他在蘇黎世主持一間法律顧問事務所。
body.en: From 1922 to 1937 he monitored, on behalf of the League of Nations and from Katowice (Poland), compliance with the German-Polish agreement on Upper Silesia. After 1937 he ran a legal consultancy office in Zürich.

citations.quote: 1922-37 überwachte er im Auftrag des Völkerbunds von Katowice (Polen) aus
die Einhaltung des deutsch-polnischen Abkommens zu Oberschlesien.
Nach 1937 leitete er ein Rechtskonsulentenbüro in Zürich.

body.zh-Hant: 普拉斯蒂拉斯（1883–1953）是希臘將軍與政治人物。1909年他參與軍中的古迪起義；1919年他以第5/42埃夫宗團團長身分參加烏克蘭戰役。1922年他是推翻君士坦丁一世的軍事政變領袖，並在1923年選舉後把權力交給選出的政府。
body.en: Nikolaos Plastiras (1883–1953) was a Greek general and politician. In 1909 he took part in the army revolt known as the Goudi revolution, and in 1919 he joined the Ukrainian campaign as commander of the 5/42nd Evzone Regiment. In 1922 he led the military coup that deposed King Constantine I, and after the 1923 elections he handed power to the elected government.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年12月英國擊潰希臘抵抗運動並占領雅典後，普拉斯蒂拉斯於1945年1月被任命為政府首腦；他簽署了瓦爾基扎協定，並於4月在美國壓力下被免職。
body.en: After the British suppression of the Greek resistance and the occupation of Athens in December 1944, Plastiras was installed as head of government in January 1945. He signed the Varkiza Agreement and was removed in April under pressure from the United States.

og besættelsen af Athen i december 1944

heading.en: City councillor, Althing member and envoy to Denmark

body.zh-Hant: 他開設自己的律師事務所，1912至1920年任雷克雅未克市議會議員。他以獨立黨（Selvstændighedspartiet）代表身分，在1914–16與1919–20年間是冰島議會議員。1920年他被任命為冰島駐丹麥使節，任職至1924年，1926年再任，直到1941年當選攝政為止。
body.en: He ran his own law firm and served on the Reykjavík City Council from 1912 to 1920. As a representative of the Independence Party (Selvstændighedspartiet) he was a member of the Althing in 1914–16 and 1919–20. In 1920 he was appointed Iceland’s ambassador to Denmark, held the post until 1924, returned to it in 1926 and served until he was elected regent in 1941.

until 1920, when he was appointed Iceland’s ambassador to Denmark.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年他以冰島議會議長身分被選為攝政（rigsforstander），1944年當選冰島首任總統；他在1945與1949年無對手連任，1952年1月25日逝世。
body.en: In 1941, as speaker of the Althing, he was elected regent (rigsforstander), and in 1944 he became Iceland’s first president. He was re-elected without opposition in 1945 and 1949 and died on 25 January 1952.

body.zh-Hant: 克雷伊奇（1892–1956）是憲法學者、法官與政治人物，學生時代即是馬薩里克的支持者。他先在摩拉維亞邦行政機關任職，1938年出任憲法法院院長，並在魯道夫·貝蘭政府中任司法部長。
body.en: Jaroslav Krejčí (1892–1956) was a constitutional lawyer, judge and politician who was already a Masaryk supporter as a student. He first served in the Moravian Provincial Administration; in 1938 he became President of the Constitutional Court and Minister of Justice in the government of Rudolf Beran.

body.zh-Hant: 巴斯克斯（1860–1936）曾任多明尼加共和國總統（1899、1902–1903、1924–1930）。1890年代他積極參與推翻獨裁者烏利塞斯·厄羅（Heureaux）的陰謀。1916至1924年美國占領期間，他是談判委員會成員，該委員會促成美國海軍陸戰隊撤離。他在華盛頓支持下參選1924年總統，1930年被陸軍司令特魯希略推翻。
body.en: Horacio Vásquez (1860–1936) was president of the Dominican Republic (1899, 1902–1903, 1924–1930). In the 1890s he was very active in plots to overthrow the dictator Ulises Heureaux. During the 1916–1924 U.S. occupation he was a member of the negotiating committee that effected the withdrawal of the U.S. Marines. Supported by Washington in his 1924 presidential bid, he was ousted in 1930 by the army commander Rafael Leónidas Trujillo Molina.
